notes.title: Demo Period Extended!
notes.notes:
Thank you, Adventurers, for your incredible support of Philna Fantasy! Over the past two weeks, we’ve received a lot of valuable feedback and suggestions from players. The demo has also drawn significant attention from new players. As a result, we’ve decided to:

[b]Extend the demo period until December 31st![/b]

During this time, we will continue to improve the demo experience based on your feedback, and work towards delivering even more exciting content in the future! Feel free to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/W83mvGQDqB

notes.title: Discord Channel Now Available! Demo Free Update!
notes.notes:
Adventurers,

Thank you all for your enthusiastic participation and valuable feedback since the demo's release. We've received many great suggestions and comments from various communities. As a result, we've made several optimizations and improvements to the game. Here are the details of this update:

1. Updated the Discord link in the game; it now works correctly, allowing users to join our Discord channel. [url=https://discord.gg/W83mvGQDqB]Join Our Discord[/url]
2. Added a prompt for controllers that are temporarily unsupported to avoid controller detection issues.
3. Fixed an issue where the Ranger could defeat the boss without triggering the boss fight.
4. Fixed an issue where some fixed locations couldn’t pick up items or open treasure chests.
5. Optimized the monkey-catching puzzle.
6. Added a vertical sync option in settings, with the default set to the monitor's best frame rate.
7. Fixed an issue where arrows shot by the Ranger had a chance of disappearing.
8. Fixed an issue where the health bar showed as empty after death.
9. Fullscreen mode can now be set from the main menu.
10. Fixed an issue where dungeons wouldn't automatically reset after completion.
11. Fixed various map exploration issues.
12. Fixed an issue where the menu screen would freeze.
13. Adjusted the conditions for the casual difficulty mode.
14. Dungeons can now be reset on the map.

Again, thank you all for your love and support for Philna Fantasy!

notes.title: Packed with Content! Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Adventurers! Welcome to the world of Philna!

[previewyoutube=0Th4ZcVf2vI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]From November 20 to December 4, [/b]Philna Fantasy will be available for a limited-time trial. You can download the Demo directly from the game store page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591150/_/

In this Demo,[b] you’ll get to experience the full content of the first chapter[/b]—take on guild quests, travel between towns and dungeons, defeat monsters, gather gear, and become a true adventurer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44606468/cb84eae61e69b220091b1f5564161544c3ffd0f2.jpg[/img]

The Demo also introduces the brand-new Pet System, giving you a trusty companion to assist on your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44606468/9e09b84c004b717a152e118d3911338561521ea2.jpg[/img]

With over 2 hours of gameplay, there’s plenty to enjoy. We hope you have a great time exploring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44606468/5bf065fc4548dee86ad881eb0e0f6972c1d7ab1f.jpg[/img]

As the game is still in development, we’d love to hear your feedback. Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/aNHzaxGz]Discord[/url] or click the icon on the Demo page to share your thoughts. 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44606468/27b60f2113014a3040b08b63500c381e6c01c8c0.jpg[/img]
